headline: Spaniard De Cos nears the ECB's top post with Germany's backing
summary: Spanish economist Pablo Hernandez de Cos moved closer to the European Central Bank presidency after Germany backed him, while saying Germany's aim is for a German to be chief economist.
why: The ECB sets monetary policy for the euro area, and its leadership influences interest rates and euro financial markets.
original_headline: El español De Cos se acerca al puesto más alto del BCE con el respaldo de Alemania
